title: Wall assembly materials.
officialText:
The face of the wall assemblies making up the exit enclosures and elevator hoistway enclosures
that are not exposed to the interior of the exit enclosure or elevator hoistway enclosure shall be constructed in accordance with one of
the following methods:
1. The wall assembly shall incorporate not less than two layers of impact-resistant construction board each of which meets or
exceeds Hard Body Impact Classification Level 2 as measured by the test method described in ASTM C 1629/C 1629M.
2. The wall assembly shall incorporate not less than one layer of impact-resistant construction material that meets or exceeds
Hard Body Impact Classification Level 3 as measured by the test method described in ASTM C 1629/C 1629M.
3. The wall assembly incorporates multiple layers of any material, tested in tandem, that meet or exceed Hard Body Impact
Classification Level 3 as measured by the test method described in ASTM C 1629/C 1629M.
